t: This is Conway Hall Ethical Society, thought to be the oldest surviving freethought organisation in the world. It was formerly the South Place Ethical Society, and it's the only ethical society left in the United Kingdom. Today it advocates secular humanism and belongs to Humanists International. The man who founded it was William Johnson Fox, an English Unitarian minister, politician and political orator. So an organisation that began with a minister's convictions has grown into one of the world's longest-lasting homes for free thought, and that's the story behind the hall you're standing at.
